Hi all,
I am Dharak Shah a second year Information and Communication Technology undergraduate student of DA-IICT , India.
I am looking forward to participate in GSoC 2012.
I am very much interested in projects about calculus and graph theory.
I have done many projects related to graph theory in java.
I had written a code of definite integration solver through graph, by plotting the graph of function,shading the required area on graph and calculates the required area.
So please tell me how to start for GSOC 2012...
Thank you
Best regards
Dharak Shah
